newsitem.title: CHINA: China bank loans 150 mln yuan to aluminium plant.
newsitem.headline: China bank loans 150 mln yuan to aluminium plant.

text.p: A branch of China Construction Bank in southwestern China has signed an agreement to grant 150 million yuan ($18 million) in working capital loans to the Guizhou Aluminium Plant, the Fiancial News said on Wednesday.
The plant based in Guiyang, capital of China's southwestern Guizhou province, planned to produce 150,000 tonnes of aluminium ingots in 1997, the newspaper said.
The sales revenue of the plant was expected to be 2.0 billion yuan and pre-tax profits 100 million yuan this year, it said but did not give further details.
